defect: The fix only swaps the comments on the two closing #endif lines so that they name the right conditions.
reason: Misordered comments after #endif do not change the preprocessor result, so this is a documentation/style fix, not a functional defect.

defect: NewColumnFamilyInfo stores a raw new ConstantColumnFamilyInfo with cf_info_map_[cf_key] = new ..., overwriting and leaking an existing entry when the same cf_key is registered twice (DB::Open plus CreateColumnFamily with create_missing_column_families).
reason: The leaking assignment was added by this change, together with the two call sites in db_impl.cc that can register the same column family twice; the fix switches the map to unique_ptr to free the old entry.

defect: The new UnSchedule test relies on a fixed 100 ms sleep for the rescheduled task to run and lets the SleepingBackgroundTask objects go out of scope without confirming the background thread is done with them, which fails under TSAN.
reason: The racy, timing-based test was added by this change and the fix replaces the sleep with a polling wait plus a check that both tasks are no longer sleeping.

defect: The new NonBottommostCompactionDropRangetombstone test drives the compactions with CompactRange on a key range and expects outcomes (one L1 file, two range deletions after the snapshot compaction) that CompactRange does not produce, so the test fails.
reason: The failing test was added by this change and the fix, landed the same day, rewrites its setup and expectations so that it passes.

defect: The new default constructor SstFileMetaData() {} leaves the inherited FileStorageInfo::file_type at its default kTempFile, so objects built by GetLiveFilesMetaData report the wrong file type.
reason: This change made SstFileMetaData inherit FileStorageInfo with an empty default constructor, and the fix sets file_type = kTableFile there; seeing the impact needs the caller that uses the default constructor.

defect: ReadTableProperties now calls table_properties_.reset(table_properties) even when rocksdb::ReadTableProperties fails, adopting an uninitialized pointer that is later dereferenced or deleted, which segfaults on old-format SST files without properties.
reason: The unconditional reset of the uninitialized local was added by this change (the old code returned early on failure), and the fix initializes the pointer to nullptr and resets only on success.

defect: The fix changes the %12d conversions for RecordIn/RecordDrop to PRIu64 because the same fix widens the counters from int to uint64_t in internal_stats.h.
reason: With the counters still int, this change's %12d was correct; the overflow-prone int type came from the earlier commit that added the fields, so nothing this change wrote was wrong.

defect: The new accumulated counters num_input_records and num_dropped_records are declared int, so they overflow (signed overflow) once total records across compactions exceed about 2^31.
reason: This change added the int fields and the fix changes them to uint64_t to remove the possible overflow; the other per-level byte counters next to them are already uint64_t.

defect: The fix renames the misspelled parameter seqeuntial to sequential in Verify and Key.
reason: A parameter-name typo has no behavioural effect, so the fix is a style change.

defect: AddKey builds Slice prev pointing into entries_ and then calls entries_.append(), which can reallocate the buffer, so SamePrefix(key, prev) reads freed memory (use-after-free).
reason: The prev slice and the following append were both added by this change, and the fix computes prev only after the append.

defect: The fix clears read_opts.prefix after the prefix scan so that later Gets do not dereference a dangling pointer to a local Slice, and renames a shadowing keystr variable.
reason: read_opts.prefix = &prefix and later Gets with the same read_opts (the read branch and the old VerifyValue) already existed before this change, so the dangling-prefix bug predates it; the rename is style.

defect: The fix defines gettid() via syscall for glibc older than 2.30 to repair a compile failure.
reason: This change only added prctl(PR_SET_PTRACER); the gettid call that fails to compile was added later by e17f310 (Support stack traces with gdb).

defect: The new coroutine MultiGetAsync/ProcessBatch passes single shared num_filter_read/num_index_read/num_sst_read counters across levels and asynchronously completing tasks, so the per-level MultiGet histograms are recorded inaccurately.
reason: The fix replaces this change's counter parameters with a per-level stats map recorded once at the end; the wrong recording itself is only visible in version_set.cc.

defect: DumpDBFileSummary ignores ParseFileName's return value and then switches on the uninitialized FileType type (and number) for names it cannot parse, such as . and .., which valgrind reports as use of uninitialized memory.
reason: The new file added the uninitialized locals and the unchecked ParseFileName calls, and the fix initializes them and skips names that fail to parse.

defect: The new check if (db->GetRootDB() != db) return Status::NotSupported(...) makes GetFromBatchAndDB reject every StackableDB wrapper (for example a TransactionDB), even on the plain path without a callback that worked before.
reason: The rejecting check was added by this change and the fix, titled 'not allowing StackableDB', removes it and casts db->GetRootDB() instead.

defect: The new --verify_checksum option is matched with strncmp on its length, so arguments with trailing characters such as --verify_checksumAAA are silently accepted instead of being rejected.
reason: This change added the prefix-only strncmp for --verify_checksum and the fix replaces it with an exact strcmp.

defect: The rewritten assert(descriptor_file_ == NULL || new_descriptor_log) lacks its terminating semicolon, so version_set.cc does not compile.
reason: The line without the semicolon was written by this change and the fix ('fix complie error') only adds the semicolon.

defect: The new header forward-declares 'class Options;' although Options is a struct, which clang turns into an error under -Werror -Wmismatched-tags in debug builds.
reason: The mismatched forward declaration was added by this change and the fix changes it to 'struct Options;'; knowing Options is a struct needs options.h.

defect: pid_t pid = syscall(SYS_gettid) implicitly narrows syscall's long result to pid_t, which breaks the clang build under -Werror (-Wshorten-64-to-32).
reason: The new file added both narrowing assignments and the fix ('Fix clang build') wraps them in static_cast<pid_t>.

defect: After renaming the constructor parameter to _shared, the initializer rand(1000 + index + shared->GetSeed()) reads the not-yet-initialized member shared instead of the parameter, causing a SIGSEGV.
reason: The -Wshadow rename in this change left shared->GetSeed() referring to the uninitialized member, and the fix changes it to _shared->GetSeed().

defect: The new private fields max_grandparent_overlap_factor_ and expanded_compaction_factor_ are never used, which breaks the clang (Mac) build with -Werror,-Wunused-private-field.
reason: This change added the two unused fields and the fix deletes them; that they are unused can only be confirmed in compaction_picker.cc.

defect: The new LRUCacheShard::Ref() returns false without taking a reference for a handle that is no longer in the cache but is still externally referenced (its key was overwritten by Insert), although such a handle can legally be referenced.
reason: The InCache()-only condition was written in this change, and the fix lets Ref() always increment refs, only removing the handle from the LRU list when it is in the cache; the handle states are described in lru_cache.h.

defect:
fprintf(stderr, "entries_per_batch_ = %ld
", entries_per_batch_) prints an int64_t with %ld, which is a format error on OS X (int64_t is long long) and breaks the -Werror build.
reason: This change added the mismatched format string next to the new int64 batch_size flag, and the fix switches it to PRIi64 to repair the OS X compile.

defect: The fix adapts table_reader_bench to later TableFactory interface changes (internal key comparator argument), uses the passed read_options for Get, and adds the tool to make.
reason: The build break comes from interface changes made after this commit, and using the local default ReadOptions for Get had no effect when this change was made, so the fix repairs nothing this change got wrong.

defect: The new StatusJni::toJavaStatusCode/toJavaStatusSubCode return the out-of-range constants 0xFF and 0xFE from functions returning jbyte (signed char), a truncation that MSVC reports as an error, so rocksjni does not compile with MSVC.
reason: The out-of-range return values were added by this change and the fix ('Fixes for MSVC compilation') changes them to 0x7F/0x7E, together with the matching Java constant.

defect: The new EstimatedActiveKeys test passes uint64_t loop values to Add(int level, uint32_t file_number, ...), and the implicit narrowing conversions break the clang build under -Werror.
reason: The uint64_t constants and loop were added by this change and the fix ('Fixed clang compile error') switches them to uint32_t with a static_cast<int> for the level.

defect: The new ReadAhead test allocates a SpecialEnv with new and never deletes it, a leak that makes the test fail under valgrind.
reason: The leaking new SpecialEnv(...) was added by this change and the fix uses the fixture's own env_ instead.

defect: The rewritten sscanf(entry->d_name, "MANIFEST-%lu%n", &num, &match) uses %lu for a uint64_t, which is unsigned long long on clang/Mac, so the -Werror format check breaks the build.
reason: This change introduced the %lu specifier with the new uint64_t num and the fix replaces it with PRIu64 to repair the broken build.

defect: The fix removes ASSERT_NE(nullptr, value) after new int so that the clang static analyzer no longer reports a possible leak on the early-return path.
reason: The reported leak path needs new to return nullptr, which cannot happen, so the fix silences an analyzer report rather than repairing a real defect.

defect: The two overloaded multiGet native methods are both defined under the short JNI name Java_org_rocksdb_RocksDB_multiGet, which does not match the mangled names JNI requires for overloaded natives, so the JVM cannot link them.
reason: This change added both short-named overloads and the fix ('Fix bug') renames them to the long JNI names ..._multiGet__JLjava_util_List_2I and ..._multiGet__JJLjava_util_List_2I.

defect: The fix replaces the %d specifiers for the uint64_t counters num_input_records and num_dropped_records with PRIu64 in the compaction summary log line.
reason: The %d/uint64_t mismatch was already in the log statement before this change (both fields were uint64_t); this change only appended an output_compression %s argument after them.

defect: SaveAtAndAfter declares SequenceNumber old_saved_seqno without an initializer and reads it in later conditions, which gcc reports as -Werror=maybe-uninitialized and so breaks the ASAN build of db_stress.
reason: The uninitialized declaration was added by this change and the fix only initializes it to 0 to restore the build.

defect: The fix moves the data-race tests' callbacks from the MergeIterator::Prev:BeforeSeekToLast sync point to MergeIterator::Prev:BeforePrev and reserves TestIterator storage, following a product fix that replaced Seek+SeekToLast with SeekForPrev.
reason: This change only commented out unused lambda parameter names; the sync point names it left unchanged became stale because of the later product change, not because of anything this change did wrong.

defect: The fix replaces the Seek(target) then SeekToLast() fallback in MergingIterator::Prev's direction switch with SeekForPrev(target), because a child that is !Valid() due to the pushed-down upper bound is wrongly sent to its last entry.
reason: The Seek-then-SeekToLast sequence was already in Prev() before this change (it only added considerStatus calls and the target variable), and the upper-bound pushdown that made it wrong came from an earlier commit.

defect: The fix defines ZSTD_STREAMING only for libzstd >= 1.4.0 and makes ZSTD_Streaming_Supported depend on it, repairing the build on libzstd 1.3.3 (Ubuntu 18.04).
reason: The build failure comes from '#define ZSTD_STREAMING' for zstd >= 1.1.3, added by the later streaming-compression commit 21345d2; this change's runtime check against 1.3.0 had no consumer that could misbehave at this commit.

defect: The new builder initializes the private member key_length_ but never uses it, which clang turns into an error under -Werror,-Wunused-private-field.
reason: This change added the unused field and its initializer and the fix ('Fixed a compile error of cuckoo_table_builder') removes them; the field declaration is in cuckoo_table_builder.h.

defect: The new MemPurgeWALSupport test increments plain uint32_t mempurge_count/sst_count from sync-point callbacks that run in background flush threads and reads them from the test thread, a data race reported by TSAN.
reason: The non-atomic counters in this test were added by this change, and the fix makes them std::atomic and reads them with exchange(0).

defect: CreateColumnFamily's new check is inverted (if (!...->Exists(column_family_name)) return InvalidArgument("Column family already exists")), so creating a new column family always fails and an existing name is accepted.
reason: The inverted condition was written in this change and the fix removes the stray negation.

defect: The new histogramData() asserts histogramType against the ticker bounds (INTERNAL_TICKER_ENUM_MAX / TICKER_ENUM_MAX) instead of the histogram bounds, so the debug bounds check before indexing histograms_ is wrong.
reason: The copy-pasted ticker bounds were added by this change and the fix replaces them with INTERNAL_HISTOGRAM_ENUM_MAX / HISTOGRAM_ENUM_MAX.

defect: The new assertion ASSERT_GT(file_ingestion_blocking_live_writes_nanos, write_thread_perf_context->write_thread_wait_nanos) compares timings from two threads that are not strictly ordered (and reads the joined thread's thread-local perf context), so the Basic test fails intermittently.
reason: This change added the flaky cross-thread timing assertion and the fix, titled 'Fix flaky test', simply removes it.
